[[File:LutiaPass.png|thumb|right|250px|Clan Nutsy soundly defeating Clan Dip.]]
{{Quote|Much-traveled pass, with the occasional roadshop.|Description}}
'''Lutia Pass''' {{J|ルテチア峠|Rutechia-tōge}} is a mountain location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It is the site of "Mission #002: Thesis Hunt", where [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] and company confront a band of thieves that have stolen a thesis.

Lutia Pass is also the site of "Mission #044: Snow in Lutia", "Mission #045: Frosty Mage", "Mission #046: Prof in Trouble", "Mission #072: Lutia Mop-up", and the [[clan]] in "Mission #101: Clan Roundup" spawns from here. Lutia Pass can be freed in "Mission #241: Lutia Pass" after "Mission #004: Desert Peril".

==Missions==
*"Mission #002: Thesis Hunt"
{{Quote|I search for my master the late Dr. Dalilei's thesis. It was taken from me by bandits as I crossed the Lutia Pass.|Dr. Coleman, Geologist}}
*"Mission #044: Snow in Lutia"
{{Quote|Would you please take my children to play in the snow on Lutia Pass? I'll make you lunch! Please watch out for monsters.|Auntie Larsu}}
*"Mission #045: Frosty Mage"
{{Quote|I saw a bad wizard doing something up in the snow mountains. He's up to no good, I know it! He was making all this ice!|Laudy, Shopkeeper's Son}}
*"Mission #046: Prof in Trouble"
{{Quote|Please find Professor Auggie. He's been gone to the Lutia Pass for three days now. Maybe he's lost, or buried in an avalanche!|Dag, Research Assistant}}
*"Mission #072: Lutia Mop-up"
{{Quote|We found another nest of those Borzoi worms in Lutia Pass! We've got four of their capos already, only three to go!|Sprohm Town Watch}}
*"Mission #241: Lutia Pass"
{{Quote|I opened a shop in Lutia Pass, but not a single customer has come yet! I think I need to advertise. Could you pass out flyers?|Bintz, Tool Shop}}
